test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Four of them are sitting at each of the corners, while the other four are sitting at the exact centre of each of the sides.

G sits in the middle of one of the sides of the table. E is an immediate neighbour of G. E sits third to the left of F. Only three people sit between F and H. B sits to the immediate left of H. C sits third to the right of A. Who sits third to the right of D?
solution:
**A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H** are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table.

Four of them are sitting at each of the corners, while the other four are sitting at the exact centre of each of the sides.

1. G sits in the middle of one of the sides of the table.

2. E is an immediate neighbour of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbd1a745616bbd330d1154cd737eccd2ab7178c0496382f42401925c0103c8b8.png] 

3. E sits third to the left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01b0d55a7ee334400c737848b3c73a5e8816b1e6084e1f7f568cfb7ddbd36ee1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c72bcfe10e502de02f57cc536242a41da493d01d739dbe3e014b430189af046.png] 

4. Only three people sit between F and H.

The above condition cannot be satisfied in Case I, so it is eliminated.

5. B sits to the immediate left of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5503b03930b0e6ab3524c2b52d7f75380bb0ef3e967e4e21fea79ec947821e7e.png] 

6. C sits third to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2a9ebd6122f41a04fc3d905c73e8b9ae63d41ce11edb0087c3d6c6cd86bb561.png] 

Only one position is vacant and only D is left, so the vacant position will be occupied by D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/403305b237fc58dadc6598b6a5cb1c7229b18d31c0ce4ffb578de3494d5b7bf6.png] 

Clearly, H sits third to the right of D.

Hence, ‘**H**’ is the correct answer.
